verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI has no documented built-in scheduler. It can run non-interactively in scripts with structured JSON or stream-JSON output, and it offers GitHub-based automated PR review and issue triage. That lets users build recurring jobs only by wrapping it in external tooling such as cron or CI. Missing for 10: a native recurring-job or schedule feature, documentation of scheduled/cron-triggered workflows (including scheduled GitHub Action runs), and independent or hands-on corroboration of recurring automation.
